name: claude-garmin
description: Your real Garmin Connect data in Claude: recovery, HRV, training load, activities, fitness markers, workouts and more.
long_description:
Brings your Garmin Connect data into Claude so training plans, recovery checks and session analyses are grounded in your real numbers.

After installing, ask Claude: "Sign me in to Garmin". If your account uses MFA (2FA), Claude will ask you for the code Garmin sends you. This is needed only once: the session is saved on your computer and refreshed automatically for months.

The server runs only on your computer. Your password is stored by Claude Desktop in the OS keychain and sent only to Garmin.
